To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) anonymous DNA probes specific for chromosome 16 were identified and mapped to the long arm of the chromosome and 2) the chromosome 16 library was constructed by flow-purifying human chromosome 16 from a human/hamster somatic cell hybrid.
29 anonymous DNA probes specific for chromosome 16 were derived from a flow-sorted library and mapped to the chromosome.

we have isolated 29 anonymous DNA clones from a flow-published human chromosome 16-specific library, 12 of these clones were shown not to be chromosome 16-specific, 6 clones were shown to be chromosome 6-specific, and these 6 clones were regionally mapped.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the isolation of chromosome 16-specific DNA probes.
the development of anonymous DNA markers for human chromosome 15.

the development of anonymous chromosome-specific probes that can be used in a variety of genetic studies, including linkage analysis, prenatal diagnosis, and the study of chromosome structure and evolution.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
these clones are specific to chromosome 16, but not specific to any particular region of the chromosome.
the 12 clones that did not map to chromosome 15 were mapped to 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 13, and 14, and the six chromosome 16 clones were mapped to 16p, 16p, and 16q.

these clones map to chromosome 15 and regionally map as follows: one clone to 15pter----15p13.1; one clone to 14q22.3----14qter; one clone to the long arm of chromosome 14; one clone to chromosome 13; one clone to a region of chromosome 13; and one clone to the short arm of chromosome 11.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
10 of 20 clones mapped to chromosome 16, 6 of which mapped to region 16q22, with 3 mapping to 16q24, 2 to 16p, and 1 to 16q12.
we have isolated 10 anonymous DNA probes that map to chromosome 6.
10 of 29 clones were mapped to chromosome 16, with 7 of 10 mapping to the long arm of chromosome 16.
The main takeaway from our work is that
flow-purified libraries are an efficient and effective way to isolate clones that can be used to generate anonymous DNA probes for chromosome-specific mapping studies.
the flow-purified chromosome 16 library was a rich source of anonymous chromosome 16 clones.
the flow-sorted library is a rich resource for the isolation of anonymous probes for human chromosomes.
